description: This file defines the LoggingCallbackManager class, which manages adding, removing, and categorizing various types of callbacks used within the litellm framework. It handles external references, callback deduplication, and callback retrieval based on type or name. The class facilitates centralized management of logging and callback functions, including support for custom loggers and generic API callbacks.

classes.name: LoggingCallbackManager
classes.description: A class that manages addition, removal, categorization, and retrieval of different callback functions and loggers within the litellm framework.
